name: Bind the Accusing Tongue
notes: Prevents the target from speaking ill of the caster until the effect is broken.

name: Blood Rush
notes: Suppresses hunger-based frenzy for up to one hour without actual feeding.

name: Communicate with Kindred Sire
notes: Creates a temporary telepathic link with the caster's sire.

name: Defense of the Sacred Haven
notes: Prevents sunlight from entering a protected area around the caster.

name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
notes: The first stake that would pierce the caster's heart disintegrates.

name: Devil's Touch
notes: Curses a mortal target so others react to them with hostility and disgust.

name: Domino of Life
notes: Lets the caster convincingly emulate one human trait for a night.

name: Engaging the Vessel of Transference
notes: Enchants a vessel to exchange blood with anyone touching it bare-handed.

name: Blood Walk
notes: Traces lineage and blood bond information from a vampire's blood sample.

name: Burning Blade
notes: Temporarily enchants a melee weapon to inflict aggravated damage on supernatural creatures.

name: Donning the Mask of Shadows
notes: Makes the subject smoky, muted, and difficult to detect by normal senses.

name: Eyes of the Night Hawk
notes: Allows the caster to see and hear through a predatory bird.

name: Machine Blitz
notes: Causes complex machines to malfunction while the caster concentrates.

name: Clinging of the Insect
notes: Allows the caster to cling to vertical surfaces and ceilings.

name: Flesh of Fiery Touch
notes: Makes the caster's flesh burn attackers who touch them.

name: Incorporeal Passage
notes: Lets the caster pass through solid barriers while insubstantial.

name: Bone of Lies
notes: Enchants a bone so its holder cannot knowingly speak a lie.

name: Firewalker
notes: Protects the caster from fire for the ritual's duration.

name: Blood Contract
notes: Creates a binding mystic contract between willing participants.

name: Enchant Talisman
notes: Permanently enchants a carried item with Thaumaturgical resonance.

name: Call of the Hungry Dead
notes: Lets the target hear voices and conversation from across the Shroud.

name: Eldritch Beacon
notes: Marks the bearer as a bright, vulnerable target in the Shadowlands.

name: Insight
notes: Shows the last moments witnessed by a corpse through its eyes.

name: Knowing Stone
notes: Marks a target's spirit so the necromancer can later learn its location.

name: Minestra di Morte
notes: Brews a death-tainted soup that lets mortals perceive nearby ghosts.

name: Eyes of the Grave
notes: Subjects the target to involuntary visions of their own death.

name: The Hand of Glory
notes: Creates a mummified hand that puts mortal occupants of a home to sleep.

name: Occhio d'Uomo Morto
notes: Grafts a dead eye to permanently grant Shroudsight with serious drawbacks.

name: Puppet
notes: Prepares a living or unwilling subject as a vessel for ghostly possession.

name: Brand
notes: Turns a recently created tattoo or body modification into a permanent mark on the vampire's flesh.

name: Chime of Unseen Spirits
notes: Enchants a metal chime to ring when unseen spirits, ghosts, or devils draw near.

name: Sigil of Authority
notes: Cuts a sigil into a bearer that projects the weight of a granted office's authority.

name: Blood into Water
notes: Transmutes spilled blood within the ritual's radius into water.

name: Blood Mastery
notes: Burns a victim's blood sympathetically to guarantee a narrow success in the next challenge against them.

name: Encrypt Missive
notes: Magically encodes a written document so only named recipients can read it.

name: Impressive Visage
notes: Heightens the caster's apparent beauty and allure for several hours.

name: Purify Blood
notes: Cleanses poison and disease from a point of blood decanted into a vessel.

name: Eyes of Babel
notes: Lets the caster read, write, and speak an otherwise unknown language for a limited time.

name: Preserve
notes: Mystically preserves a small object against age and ordinary wear for decades.

name: Seal Egress
notes: Seals a room closed against entry or escape until the passphrase is spoken.

name: Craft Bloodstone
notes: Creates a mystic pebble whose direction and general distance are always known to its maker.

name: Extinguish
notes: Allows the caster to snuff out fires up to bonfire size with a spoken syllable.

name: Illusion of Peaceful Death
notes: Makes a corpse appear to have died naturally instead of from violence.

name: Preservation of the Sanguine Heart
notes: Temporarily protects the target against blood bonds and the Vaulderie.

name: Summon the Blood Imp
notes: Creates a malicious but loyal blood-fed servitor from stitched corpses and vitae.

name: Vigil of the Stone Guardian
notes: Enchants a stone door-knocker into a sentry that warns and can be remotely possessed.

name: Mirror Prison
notes: Creates an astral prison cell inside a specially prepared silver mirror.

name: Preserve Corpse
notes: Creates an elixir that indefinitely preserves dead flesh from rot.

name: Haunting Breeze
notes: Summons a supernatural wind of whispers that frightens mortals and hampers perception.

name: Death's Head
notes: Enchants a mask that makes the wearer appear ghostlike, even in the Shadowlands.

name: Impregnable Soul
notes: Shields the subject against possession and spiritual displacement.

name: Enochian Passage
notes: Allows the vampire to physically pass into the Shadowlands and emerge near Enoch.
